title: fix(plugin-form): drawer, tabbed and wizard edit forms for a record that does not exist show the not-found state, not an empty editable form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3Z5yLX6trsrar5zLPSuFd8)_

Fixes #29247

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Declarations as set by the claim (card comment 6576081714), which fixes the file surface: `DrawerForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx`, `loadFailure.ts` (a module-private shared helper only), `ModalForm.tsx` only because its not-found drawing moved into that helper, their tests and a root changeset.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:抽屉表单、分页签表单和向导表单在编辑一条不存在的记录时，现在显示「Record not found」未找到状态(与记录页和 `?form=` 弹窗相同的文案),不再显示可编辑的空白表单，也没有「更新」按钮。四种记录表单共用 `loadFailure.ts` 里同一个私有组件来画这个状态。新建和编辑已存在的记录不变。
- **为什么改**:用户从已删除记录的旧链接进入这三种表单，会看到空白表单，填完点更新才被告知记录不存在;PR #29246 只修了弹窗表单。
- **风险与回滚**:低。三处记录读取 effect 在 `findOne` 返回 `null` 时记一次 `RecordNotFoundError` 加载失败、不再把 `{}` 填进表单;原有的「加载失败时不画表单和底栏」路径接管其余。表单打开期间后台重读发现记录已删，也显示同一状态。`ModalForm` 只是改为调用共享组件，行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/loadFailure.ts` 末尾的 `RecordNotFoundState`;`DrawerForm.tsx` 记录读取 effect 的 `data == null` 分支与 `renderContent` 开头的分支;`WizardForm.tsx` 同一处(它还设置 `persistedRecord`)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/recordNotFound-29247.test.tsx packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.recordNotFound-29157.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、16 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A null edit read is a failure, not an empty record, in every record form.** `DataSource.findOne` is typed `T | null`, and the ObjectStack adapter's `readOne` answers `null` when the server answers 404. `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm` ran `setFormData(data || {})` (the wizard also `setPersistedRecord(data || {})`) and committed, so an edit form for a deleted or unknown record drew a blank editable form with an enabled Update button. Each now fails the read with the package-private `RecordNotFoundError`, through the per-read failure run every other load failure uses, and the form is not seeded. This is the branch PR #29246 gave `ModalForm`.
- **One drawing for the state.** `loadFailure.ts` gains a module-private `RecordNotFoundState`: `Empty` with `EmptyTitle` and `EmptyDescription`, reading the existing pack keys `empty.recordNotFound` and `empty.recordNotFoundDescription` through its own `createSafeTranslation` table (the `en` values, so a provider-less host still reads English). Each of the four layouts draws it ahead of the generic "Error loading form" box when the shown failure is a `RecordNotFoundError`; the drawer keeps its footer off while a load failure is shown, as before, and the tabbed and wizard layouts return the state in place of the form. `ModalForm`'s inline copy of the same drawing and its two table rows move into the helper; its test id is kept.
- **Also on a background re-read.** A bus re-read (`useRecordInvalidation`) that finds the record deleted while the form is open shows the same state.
- **Unchanged.** Create (or no id) never reads; an edit of a record that exists draws its form as before. No new string, no new export from the package entry, no prop or schema change.

## Why

A user who opens an old link to a deleted record in a drawer, tabbed or wizard form saw a blank form, filled it in, and learned the record did not exist only on save.

## Tests

- New `recordNotFound-29247.test.tsx`, one `describe.each` over `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm` (each an `object-form` in edit mode with one section, the real registered fields): a `null` read draws "Record not found", its description and the layout's test id, with no `title` input, no Update button and no "Error loading form"; a found record that a bus re-read then finds deleted switches to the same state; CONTROL a found record still draws its form and Update; CONTROL a create draws an empty form with Create and never calls `findOne`.
- `ModalForm.recordNotFound-29157.test.tsx` (unchanged) holds `ModalForm` after its drawing moved into the helper.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live console not measured.** The chain is pinned in vitest from the `findOne` answer down; the adapter's 404 to `null` mapping is read from `ObjectStackAdapter.readOne`, not re-exercised.
- **The helper is built with `createElement`** because `loadFailure.ts` stays a `.ts` module as the claim names it; the `data-testid` prop is typed onto `Empty`'s props instead of cast.
- **`setFormData(data)`** in the three layouts: after the `null` branch the `|| {}` fallback could no longer fire, so it is dropped. `ModalForm`'s own line is left as it is.
- **One lint warning in the new test** (`no-explicit-any` on the parametrised layout type), the same documented shape and reason as `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`: the four layouts share no props base.
